edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet (Stun): matchup-defining — Her stun setup — dodge it and the dive falls apart. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Nevermove has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
